what: A revokes invite 3 from the door (its row's Revoke): an invite.revoke event

actions.eval: (() => { const nonce = 'q7dnog6e'; const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const row = [...l.querySelectorAll('div')].filter(d => d.innerText.startsWith(nonce) && [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Revoke')).sort((a, b) => a.innerText.length - b.innerText.length)[0]; if (!row) return 'no row'; const btn = [...row.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Revoke'); btn.click(); return 'revoked ' + row.innerText.slice(0, 80) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; if (w.status.pending === 0 && Object.values(w.now.events).some(e => e.kind === 'invite.revoke')) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l.innerText; const i = t.indexOf('Invites'); return t.slice(i, i + 700) })()
